name: calorie-tracker
description: Plate: a calorie and macro tracker built with React, Node.js, Express and PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.render-build: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build
scripts.start: npm run db:setup --prefix server && npm start --prefix server
